newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firmer with gilts after Dow rebound.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firmer with gilts after Dow rebound.

text.p: UK shares opened firmer on Wednesday after the Dow recouped Monday's loss and pushed back above the 6,000 mark, dealers said.
At 0841 GMT, the FTSE 100 index of leading shares was up 11.6 at 4,005.1 points.
The Dow, up only 2.61 points when London markets closed, finished 34.29 points higher at 6,007.02 after fresh economic data settled jitters about an acceleration in inflation.
Gilts also opened higher, lending support to UK equities. But caution is expected to reign in London this morning ahead of today's UK monetary meeting, dealers said.
